rollbackReferences.note: References preserve provenance, not permission to launch vulnerable or incompatible images.

registry.requiredBeforeCloudRun: Separate owner-authorized Artifact Registry enrollment/publication; confirm registry content digest/provenance against these local OCI identities. No publication performed.

transition.drain: Stop new actions to old revisions, drain configured factory owner slots (existing8s drain/5s permits), fence old workers; retain charges for lost/uncertain sends. No resend/refund.
transition.sessions: Explicitly revoke/fence old outings before switching. Changed cohort rejects old ticket/evidence build; native_incompatible_evidence is not permission to reconstruct or repeat inference. No automatic migration/TTL renewal.
transition.financialEpoch: Retain the independently verified current epoch; an image/package update does not authorize rotation, a new grant, reset counters or renewed expiry. If consistency cannot be proven, refuse/quarantine and use separately approved reconciliation.
transition.schema: No SQL/schema/RLS/financial-policy migration in this proposal. New build/config enrollment must be separately reviewed while preserving grant identities, balances and replay history.
transition.rollback: Code-only artifact rollback requires explicit approval, drains/revokes current sessions and fences workers. Never restore operational/Redis/witness snapshots or resurrect old capabilities/allowances.
transition.startup: Both proposed contracts remain launchable=false; fixed runtime configuration/enrollment paths, schema/role/build/epoch checks and real-provider refusals remain intact.

separateDeploymentGates: qualified cloud LLM and independently verified provider-specific token/count/price policy
reviewed real provider credentials/transports and explicit financial grant
Google content use/retention/attribution enrollment (unchanged ID-only permission is insufficient)
real IAM/IAP tester/service identities, SecretManager configuration and exact resource/provider spending approval
existingCloudTemplates: Existing frontend/backend templates are inert legacy review templates, not a ready-to-apply six-service deployment. Do not treat image bindings as full IAM/network/secret enrollment. Reuse the existing hosted-enrollment contract when separately authorized.
